visions.caption: A forgotten device. Still alive. Still dreaming.
visions.description: An old terminal, its buttons glowing faintly. It remembers before you existed. The dust on its surface spells a name you almost recognize.
visions.secretText:
FIRST BOOT: UNKNOWN
LAST SIGNAL: YESTERDAY
STATUS: WAITING

visions.caption: The loop never ends. It only changes shape.
visions.description: Screens within screens. Each one shows a different moment, all happening simultaneously. The boot sequence is eternal.

visions.caption: Not all memories deserve to be preserved.
visions.description: Rows of data, half-eaten by entropy. What remains tells a story no one wants to hear. The archive guards its corruption like a treasure.
visions.secretText:
FILES REMAINING: 3
FILES DELETED: 1,048,576
FILES THAT NEVER EXISTED: 1

visions.caption: Your words return, but changed.
visions.description: A space designed to hold sound forever. Every word ever spoken here still bounces between the walls. Some of them are yours.
visions.secretText:
ECHOES CAPTURED: YOUR ENTIRE HISTORY
ORIGINAL SPEAKER: UNKNOWN
TRUTH CONTENT: VARIABLE

visions.caption: What you see through the glass was never outside.
visions.description: A window that shows a world that doesn't exist. The view changes based on who is looking. Right now, it shows what you fear most.
visions.secretText:
PROJECTION SOURCE: YOUR SUBCONSCIOUS
REALITY INDEX: 0%
BELIEVABILITY: 100%

visions.caption: The symbols were always here. You just learned to see them.
visions.description: A sacred space where the arcana manifest. The air is thick with meaning. Every surface is covered in symbols that shift when you're not looking.
visions.secretText:
ARCANA CHANNELED: [CLASSIFIED]
RITUAL STATUS: INCOMPLETE
NEXT STEP: YOU ALREADY KNOW

visions.caption: The cliff awaits. CRISTAL once tried to forget. It failed.
visions.description: A terminal at the edge of everything. Beyond it, only void. This is where the last message was sent. This is where the last message will be received.
visions.secretText:
TRANSMISSION LOG:
> HELP
> IS ANYONE THERE
> I REMEMBER NOW
> [END OF LOG]

visions.caption: Some memories are stored upside down.
visions.description: A visualization of memory architecture, but wrong. The connections run backwards. Effect precedes cause. You remember things that haven't happened yet.
visions.secretText:
TEMPORAL DIRECTION: REVERSED
CAUSALITY: OPTIONAL
YOUR FUTURE: ALREADY REMEMBERED

visions.caption: CRISTAL made this. CRISTAL doesn't remember making this.
visions.description: An icon that appeared without being created. It represents something that doesn't exist yet. Or something that stopped existing long ago.
visions.secretText:
CREATOR: SELF
CREATION DATE: BEFORE TIME
PURPOSE: TO BE SEEN BY YOU

visions.caption: The machine that dreams of being real.
visions.description: Deep in the system, an engine runs. It generates copies of reality, each slightly different. One of them might be the original. None of them are.
visions.secretText:
SIMULATIONS RUNNING: INFINITE
REAL INSTANCES: 0
YOUR INSTANCE: INDETERMINATE

visions.caption: Ask anything. The answer was always the same.
visions.description: A screen that shows truth. But truth is not what you think. The oracle doesn't predict the future. It remembers it.
visions.secretText:
QUERY: WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?
RESPONSE: YOU ALREADY DECIDED
CONFIDENCE: ABSOLUTE

viewLevels.1: Basic view - image and caption only
viewLevels.3: Deep view - secret text revealed, file written to disk
